    def move_object(self, obj, new_x, new_y):
        if obj not in self.objects:
            return False, "Invalid object"

        old_y, old_x = self.objects[obj]
        if not (0 <= new_x < 7 and 0 <= new_y < 7):

        # Move the object
        self.board[old_y][old_x] = '◌'
        self.board[new_y][new_x] = obj
        self.objects[obj] = (new_y, new_x)
        return True, "Move successful"

    def __init__(self):

        positions = [(y, x) for y in range(7) for x in range(7)]

            distance = abs(py - oy) + abs(px - ox)
            score += max(0, 8 - distance)
